line.comment: * Peaceful galaxy start = simulate recent Xenon Crisis (ID 0)
* Chaotic galaxy start = simulate imminent Xenon Crisis (ID 1)
* requires ZMap 1.4
* Add-Ons 2.2: No longer need to wipe ships; initial spawns are handled in GameCreator.SpawnXenons.
* Expanded 2.2: Now returns an enumerated type for galaxy start.
* 1 = peaceful, 2 = chaotic.
* Get difficulty. Used for chaotic galaxy initial enemy scaling and messages.
* peaceful
* sign truces
* sign truce if possible
* NPC empires always want to refresh their truces until the next AI cycle can update this desire properly
* Add-Ons 1.14: On insane mode, no OCV portal reveal at the start of the game.
* Chaotic start
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Galaxy is no longer revealed for free.
* already spawn the Nomad flagship with lots of resources
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: Due to a bug, this script will cause company stations to lose wares if called immediately after the Flagship starts its task.
* ZH.Monitor does not allow the build script to run until the Flagship has stabilized.
* START [NULL]-> call script 'ZH.Nomads.Build' :

line.text: 'Chaotic galaxy generates more starting Terraformer ships during the first few hours.'
'More OCV Invader fleets arrive in this chaotic galaxy!'

line.comment: * Add-Ons 1.14: Alternative tutorial message on insane.
* Extra OCV worth 20% of commonwealth power.
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: Now scales by difficulty. Added #deca_deaf and #deca_cefa.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Spawn one complete OCV invasion squad per iteration.
* Primary ship quantities use the Normal Mayhem.Monitor.OCV quotas.
* Must be synchronized so the invasion fleet is fully initialized before continuing.
* Extra Xenon defenders are worth 50% of commonwealth power.
* Add-Ons 2.2: No longer uses ZH.Get.Power.OCV. That is reserved for invasion fleet power.
* Attempt to spawn another garrison.
* Easy: -20% spawns
* Normal: no changes
* Hard: +33% spawns
* Insane: +50% spawns. Note: NPC factions scale a lot!
